Film Review: 'Possible Love' Explores Class and Relationships

The film 'Possible Love,' directed by Lee Chang-dong, explores themes of love, longing, and class divisions through the interconnected stories of two couples. One couple is wealthy, played by Zo In-sung and Cho Yeo-jeong, while the other is less affluent, portrayed by Sul Kyung-gu and Jeon Do-yeon. The movie is described as a delicate drama set in anxious times and is considered a masterful critique of Korean society.
